name: DUMBBELL WOODCHOP RIGHT
introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Hold a dumbbell in your hands with your legs slightly bent. Place the dumbbell next to the outside of your right thigh. \n\nStraighten your legs, twist your torso to the left, and lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body. Bring the dumbbell back and repeat.

tips.text: Use your core muscles to control the rotation.
Control the dumbbell, don\'t swing the dumbbell around.
This exercise works your core, specially your obliques.
